agent_comment: The column holds the study participant number, so it maps to the CDISC subject identifier (SUBJID); Subject Unique Identifier (NCIT:C69256) was rejected because it denotes an identifier unique across studies.

The column names the recruiting centre, so per the guidelines it records the site's identifier rather than the site itself (Study Site, NCIT:C80403, rejected; Study Site Number, NCIT:C83100, rejected as it implies numeric codes).

description: biological sex as recorded at screening
agent_comment: The description specifies biological sex, so the CDISC Sex concept fits despite the column name; Gender (NCIT:C17357) and Sex at Birth (NCIT:C124436) were rejected.
Birth Year (synonym Year of Birth, BRTHYR) is the year in which a person was born.
Number of Years of Education (EDUYRNUM) matches years of formal education; Education Level (NCIT:C17953) was rejected as a categorical attainment.
Dominant Hand (HANDDOM) records the preferred hand, which is what R/L/both captures; PATO handedness (PATO:0002201) was rejected because demographics go to NCIT.
Study Subject Enrolled Date (synonym Date of Enrollment) is the date a subject is formally enrolled in the study.
Informed Consent Date (RFICDAT) is the date the participant gave informed consent.

description: any first degree relative with Parkinson's
agent_comment: No term for family history of Parkinson disease in first-degree relatives was found, so the generic Family Medical History is the closest broader term; HPO Family history (HP:0032316) is an equally broad alternative.
Clinical idiopathic PD is the enrolment diagnosis Parkinson disease in MONDO; no separate idiopathic or sporadic PD term was found, and monogenic PD subtypes were rejected.
MSA-P is the parkinsonian type of multiple system atrophy; the parent multiple system atrophy (MONDO:0007803) was rejected as broader.
Clinical PSP maps to the MONDO disease progressive supranuclear palsy; the PSP-parkinsonism variant (MONDO:0009839) was rejected as narrower.
MONDO Lewy body dementia carries the synonyms DLB and dementia with Lewy bodies, matching the consensus-criteria diagnosis.

Age Symptom Started covers the onset of any illness-specific symptom, which is broader than the age at the first motor symptom; no motor-specific onset-age term was found, and exactMatch is a reasonable alternative reading.
Age at Diagnosis is the generic term, and naming PD as context does not narrow it; the definition's wording on pathologic diagnosis lowers confidence slightly.

Following the guidelines, carrier status is related to the LRRK2 genetic disease (PARK8); the LOINC LRRK2 Arg1441Gly and Gly2019Ser targeted mutation analysis (LOINC:82139-7) was rejected because it covers two variants and records a report rather than G2019S carrier status.
Bradykinesia on exam is the HPO sign Bradykinesia.

Rest tremor present in any limb is the HPO sign Resting tremor; broadMatch is a defensible alternative because the variable excludes non-limb rest tremor and HPO has no limb-specific rest-tremor term (Limb tremor, HP:0200085, rejected).
Rigidity on exam is the HPO sign Rigidity; the narrower Cogwheel rigidity (HP:0002396) and Extrapyramidal muscular rigidity (HP:0007076) were rejected.
Postural instability on the pull test matches HPO Postural instability, whose definition cites the retropulsion test.
Freezing episodes when walking is the HPO sign Freezing of gait.

description: reduced sense of smell, self report
agent_comment: A self-reported reduced sense of smell is HPO Hyposmia; Partial hyposmia (HP:0010635) was rejected as narrower.
No sense of smell is HPO Anosmia; Total anosmia (HP:0010632) was rejected as an unnecessary refinement.

description: dream enactment / RBD, pt or partner reported
agent_comment: Dream enactment reported by the participant or partner is recorded as a sign, so it maps to the HPO term REM sleep behavior disorder rather than a MONDO disease.
Fewer than 3 bowel movements a week or laxative use is the HPO sign Constipation; Chronic constipation (HP:0012450) was rejected as narrower.
A 20/10 mmHg drop on standing defines HPO Orthostatic hypotension; the autonomic-dysfunction subtype (HP:0004926) was rejected as narrower.
Urinary urgency maps directly to the HPO term of the same name.
Per the guidelines, a clinician-judged condition other than the enrolment diagnosis is a sign or symptom, so it maps to HPO Depression rather than a MONDO depressive disorder.
Visual hallucinations in the last month is HPO Visual hallucination, and the recall window does not change the concept; the parent Hallucinations (HP:0000738) was rejected.

HPO has no mild cognitive impairment term, so PD-MCI is mapped as a sign to the broader HPO Cognitive impairment; NCIT Mild Cognitive Impairment (NCIT:C215366) as an exactMatch is a close alternative.
reviewer_note: Kept the gold standard: NCIT Mild Cognitive Impairment is closer than the much broader HPO term.

agent_comment: HPO has no levodopa-induced dyskinesia term, so the broader HPO Dyskinesia is used; MONDO drug-induced dyskinesia (MONDO:0006732) was rejected because it is a disease term for a sign, and Extrapyramidal dyskinesia (HP:0007308) is a possible alternative.
Difficulty swallowing is HPO Dysphagia.

agent_comment: This is the Hoehn and Yahr stage item of the MDS-UPDRS; the modified Hoehn and Yahr stage of the original UPDRS (LOINC:77714-4, NCIT:C100943) was rejected, as the guidelines require.
LOINC has a code for the MoCA total score, so it is preferred over NCIT Montreal Cognitive Assessment Total Score (NCIT:C162720).

object_label: Geriatric depression scale (GDS) short version total
agent_comment: The 15-item GDS short form total maps to the LOINC short version total; the long-form GDS total (LOINC:48544-1) was rejected.
No LOINC or NCIT code for the ESS total score was found, so the NCIT instrument is a broad match.

agent_comment: No LOINC or NCIT code for the SCOPA-AUT total score was found, so the NCIT instrument is a broad match.

agent_comment: LOINC has the Schwab and England ADL scale, but only within the original UPDRS, which may differ from the standalone (modified) scale used here; NCIT UPDRS - Schwab and England % ADL Score (PD) (NCIT:C111611) and the with-dyskinesia variant (LOINC:77716-9) were rejected.

description: smell ID test, 40 items, total correct
agent_comment: Searches for UPSIT, smell identification, University of Pennsylvania, smell test, odor identification and olfactory test in LOINC and NCIT found no term for the 40-item smell identification test total; NCIT Odor Detection (NCIT:C139027) was rejected as a materials-testing concept.

object_label: REM Sleep Behavior Disorder Screening Questionnaire
agent_comment: No LOINC or NCIT code for the RBDSQ total score was found, so the NCIT instrument (synonym RBDSQ) is a broad match.

No LOINC code exists for an alpha-synuclein seed amplification result, so the protein is a related match per the guidelines; NCIT Alpha Synuclein Protein Measurement (NCIT:C142272) was rejected because it is quantitative, and the tissue immunostain code (LOINC:49456-7) because its specimen and method differ.

object_label: Amyloid beta 42 peptide [Mass/volume] in Cerebrospinal Fluid
agent_comment: Component, CSF specimen and mass/volume property (pg/mL) all agree; the plasma code (LOINC:33200-7) and the ratio codes were rejected.
Total tau mass concentration in CSF with no method stated matches the method-less code; the immunoassay-specific code (LOINC:101649-2) was rejected because the variable states no method.

object_label: Phosphorylated tau 181 [Mass/volume] in Cerebrospinal Fluid by Immunoassay
agent_comment: Component, CSF specimen, mass/volume property (pg/mL) and the stated immunoassay method all agree; the plasma code (LOINC:103675-5) was rejected.

object_label: Neurofilament light chain [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma by Immunoassay
agent_comment: A serum NfL result in pg/mL measured by Simoa (an immunoassay) matches the Ser/Plas mass immunoassay code, as no serum-only code exists; the molar plasma code (LOINC:112614-3) was rejected, and broadMatch is possible if Ser/Plas is read as broader than serum.

object_label: Neurofilament light chain [Moles/volume] in Plasma by Immunoassay
agent_comment: Plasma NfL in pmol/L requires a moles/volume code, and this is the only one; the mass code for Ser/Plas (LOINC:101281-4) was rejected.

object_label: Neurofilament light chain [Mass/volume] in Cerebrospinal Fluid
agent_comment: NfL in CSF in ng/L (a mass unit) matches the CSF mass/volume code.
A SomaScan RFU value is relative and has no LOINC code, so the measurement is related to the NCIT protein GPNMB, as the guidelines require; the GPNMB Gene term (NCIT:C113114) was rejected.
An Olink NPX value is relative and has no LOINC code, so the measurement is related to the NCIT protein GPNMB, as the guidelines require; the GPNMB Gene term (NCIT:C113114) was rejected.
An Olink NPX value is relative and has no LOINC code, so the measurement is related to the NCIT protein Cathepsin B; the CTSB Gene term (NCIT:C28405) was rejected.

object_label: C reactive protein [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma by High sensitivity method
agent_comment: Serum CRP in mg/L (mass) by a high-sensitivity method matches this Ser/Plas code; the code with no method (LOINC:1988-5) and the moles code (LOINC:76486-0) were rejected.
Serum uric acid in umol/L requires the moles/volume code; the mass code (LOINC:3084-1) and the mass-or-moles code (LOINC:35232-8) were rejected.
HbA1c reported in % is the mass fraction of total haemoglobin in blood with no method stated; the HPLC (LOINC:17856-6) and IFCC (LOINC:59261-8) codes were rejected.
The red cell count per uL in CSF matches the number-concentration code for CSF; the body fluid code (LOINC:26455-6) was rejected.

Laboratory Test Fasting Status (LBFAST) records whether the specimen came from a fasted subject; the close alternatives Fasting Status at Specimen Collection (NCIT:C70928) and Fasting Status Indicator (NCIT:C93566) could equally be chosen.
reviewer_note: The agent is right: the CDISC laboratory fasting-status term fits as well as the term accepted in v1.

agent_comment: Searches for freeze-thaw, freeze thaw, thaw cycle, number of thaw and thawed in NCIT, OBI and LOINC found no term for a count of freeze-thaw cycles; Thawed Specimen (NCIT:C158280) was rejected as a specimen condition rather than a count.

description: DaT-SPECT specific binding ratio, left putamen
